about_the_game:
STORY BACKGROUND
In an age when dark magic ravaged the continent, a valiant king discovered an ancient relic pulsating with boundless energy. Harnessing its power, he banished the demons to the abyssal seas and sealed the relic within his citadel, ushering in an era of peace. But as the king aged, his heir succumbed to the relic's temptations. The prince stole the artifact, vowing to forge an empire drenched in bloodshed. Now, as corruption spews from the fractured seal, the realm teeters on oblivion. Rally your allies, reclaim the relic, and restore the light—before the abyss devours all.

GAME OVERVIEW
This is a 2D pixel-art card tactics & grid-strategy game where players build decks and command a team of adventurers on a tactical board. Face procedurally generated enemies and terrain, expand your party through roguelike adventures, and craft synergies between cards, relics, and equipment. With every turn, strategically position units and play cards to defeat enemies before the spreading Curse overwhelms the realm. In Game you’ll:

  • Recruit unique heroes with evolving skills;

  • Forge synergistic decks merging spells, terrain manipulation, and unit synergies;

  • Outthink procedurally generated foes across shifting battle grids;

  • Race against corruption—every battle accelerates the spreading blight.

Survive long enough to challenge the final boss and save the land!
